title: Program Proposers
summary: This module provides tools for analyzing datasets and language model programs, generating observations, and proposing optimized instructions for individual modules within a program. It helps in understanding program structure and improving LM prompts.

nodes.label: Summarize Dataset Observations
nodes.title: Observation Summarizer
nodes.description: Takes a series of observations about a dataset and condenses them into a brief 2-3 sentence summary, highlighting the most important details.

nodes.label: Generate Dataset Observations
nodes.title: Dataset Descriptor
nodes.description: Analyzes sample data points from a dataset to identify trends and patterns, generating observations about topics, content, and syntax, and inferring the dataset's task.

nodes.label: Generate Observations with Prior Context
nodes.title: Dataset Descriptor with Prior Observations
nodes.description: Extends dataset analysis by incorporating existing observations, adding new insights or confirming completeness based on provided examples.

nodes.label: Describe Program Task & Flow
nodes.title: Describe Program
nodes.description: Analyzes pseudocode and an example of a language model program to describe its intended task and how it operates to solve that task.

nodes.label: Describe Module's Role
nodes.title: Describe Module
nodes.description: Focuses on a specific module within a larger language model program, describing its purpose and contribution to the overall program's functionality.

nodes.label: Generate LM Instruction
nodes.title: Generate Single Module Instruction
nodes.description: Generates a new, optimized instruction for a Language Model, leveraging dataset descriptions, program details, module descriptions, task demonstrations, and historical instruction performance.

nodes.label: Format Instruction History
nodes.title: Create Instruction Set History String
nodes.description: Processes trial logs to extract and format a history of instruction sets and their associated scores, useful for informing subsequent instruction generation.

groups.label: Dataset Analysis
groups.title: Dataset Analysis and Summarization
groups.description: Components for analyzing dataset examples, generating observations, and summarizing key insights to understand data characteristics.

groups.label: Program Structure Analysis
groups.title: Program and Module Structure Analysis
groups.description: Components dedicated to understanding the structure and function of language model programs and their individual modules from pseudocode and examples.

groups.label: Instruction Generation
groups.title: Language Model Instruction Generation
groups.description: The core component responsible for proposing new, optimized instructions for Language Models based on various contextual inputs.

groups.label: Utility Functions
groups.title: Instruction History Utility
groups.description: A utility function for processing and formatting historical instruction sets and their performance scores.
